notes:
TIER 1 (direct HTTP) sufficient - no Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt allows crawling (only search/filter/account paths disallowed). Site is Angular/Spartacus (SAP Commerce Cloud) SSR - initial HTML (ng-state) does not embed PLP product grids, but the site's own public OCC REST API was located from the main.*.js bundle (backend.occ.baseUrl=https://apisap.fabindia.com, baseSiteId=fabindiab2c) and used directly to pull the SAME data the PLP renders client-side: GET https://apisap.fabindia.com/occ/v2/fabindiab2c/products/search?query=:relevance:allCategories:<slug>&fields=... This is the site's own structured/API count (QTY tier 2), verified authoritative by: (a) an unknown category code returns HTTP 400 'Category ... not found' (confirmed with a nonsense code), (b) a nonsense /collection/<slug> URL returns HTTP 404 while every slug used below returns 200, (c) breadcrumbCategories/facets returned by the API match the page's own <title> tag exactly (e.g. dhanteras-home-living -> title 'Shop Dhanteras Home & Living'), and (d) for parent/child pairs where the child category facet values summed exactly to the parent total (Navaratri, Yoga Day), confirming the counts are real and consistent. Discovery method: pulled https://www.fabindia.com/sitemap-category.xml (27k+ URLs) and grepped for every holiday/festival keyword (diwali, christmas, halloween, eid, easter, thanksgiving, holi, raksha bandhan/rakhi, new year, valentine, mother's/father's day, durga puja, navaratri, onam, ganesh chaturthi, karva chauth, dussehra, republic/independence day, women's/men's day, yoga day, basant, dhanteras, xmas, etc.), then confirmed each candidate slug's product count via the OCC API and scoped to Home & Living / Home Decor department only (productgender facet = 'home & living' = 100% of results in every included row, i.e. these pages contain zero fashion/apparel items).

DIWALI - checked specifically and thoroughly per instructions: the literal word 'diwali' does not appear anywhere in the category sitemap, and every /collection/diwali* and /collection/diwali-home-decor* guess returned 404 (not yet live for the upcoming Oct/Nov 2026 Diwali - current date is Sept 4 2026). HOWEVER Dhanteras (the opening day of the Diwali festival, a widely-recognized part of the Diwali celebration period in India) has a live, populated Home & Living PLP: dhanteras-home-living (80 products, title 'Shop Dhanteras Home & Living'). Included this under category 'Diwali' since it is unambiguously part of the Diwali festival on this site (a separate dhanteras-silver-jewellery page exists too but is jewellery/fashion, out of scope).

INCLUDED (genuine site-labeled festival/celebration Home & Living or Home Decor PLPs, each independently verified via the OCC API and cross-checked against the rendered page <title>): Diwali/Dhanteras, Christmas (xmas-home-living), Durga Puja, Navaratri (+7 real sub-categories: Kitchen & Dining, Home Decor, Bed Linen, Curtains, Cushions, Lighting, Floor Coverings - child counts sum exactly to the parent's total, confirming Navaratri Home & Living is a pure grouping node, flagged is_group=true so it is not double-counted), Holi, Valentine's Day, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Raksha Bandhan (rakhi-accessories-gift-packaging - the only nonzero Home & Living/decor node under Rakhi; rakhi-dining-decor-gifts exists as a valid category code but is currently empty, 0 products, excluded as legit-zero), Onam, Ganesh Chaturthi, Republic Day, International Women's Day, International Men's Day, and International Yoga Day (+3 real sub-categories Bath/Home Decor/Floor Coverings whose counts sum exactly to the parent total - flagged is_group=true). Per explicit instruction, Mother's/Father's Day and the other 'day' observances were evaluated under the same genuine-PLP test as any holiday (real API-backed count, real dedicated URL, site's own <title> names the occasion) rather than excluded as generic gift occasions - all passed.

EXCLUDED after verification: (1) New Year (new-year) - checked, its only category facets are Women's/Men's/Kids' Clothing (100% fashion), zero Home Decor presence -> not included. (2) Karva Chauth - karva-chauth-home-living exists as a valid category code but returns 0 products (fashion/personal-care only for this occasion) -> legit-zero, excluded. (3) Christmas/Diwali/Holi/etc. broader 'sale' or umbrella pages: durga-puja (4179 results), navaratri (1487), festive (5100), holi-special (5918), valentines-day (4337), fathers-day (978), mothers-day (4669), rakhi (411), xmas (unchecked top total), dhanteras (top total) - these are mixed-department 'shop the whole festival' hub pages that include fashion/apparel/jewellery alongside home items; excluded as out-of-department per task scope (only their dedicated Home & Living / Home Decor child pages were included). (4) 'Festive' (festive-home-living, festive-home-decor, festive-*) - excluded: not tied to any one specific named holiday: page title is 'Buy Festival Wear & Home Decor for Friends & Family' (a generic festive-season merchandising bucket, analogous to a storewide seasonal sale, not a genuine single-holiday category). (5) Basant / Indian Spring (basant-home-living, indian-spring-home-living/decor) - excluded: page titles read 'Spring Home & Living' / 'Indian Spring Home & Living', i.e. a generic weather-season aesthetic collection, not a specific festival (Basant Panchami is not named in the title or copy). (6) Summer/Monsoon/Winter home-living - excluded as pure weather-season merchandising, not holidays. (7) Wedding, Party, Combo Offer, Curated, Handcrafted, Indigo, Kitchen, Lounge, Print Stories, New In, Outdoor Dinner Party, Workwear home-living/home-decor - excluded as generic merchandising/lifestyle collections unrelated to any calendar holiday. (8) Independence Day (independence-day-home-living) - valid category code but 0 products -> legit-zero, excluded. (9) Small subset duplicate rows skipped to avoid double-counting: durga-puja-home-decor (2, a tiny subset already inside durga-puja-home-living's 680), festive-home-decor (2, subset of festive-home-living, itself excluded), ganesh-chaturthi-home-decor (2, subset of ganesh-chaturthi-home-living's 488), valentines-day-home-decor-gifts (2, subset of valentines-day-home-living-gifts' 462), republic-day-bath/bed-linen/home-decor/kitchen-dining/lighting (5+2+1+1+1=10, negligible subsets of republic-day-home-living's 322, most of which is untagged), mothers-day-home-living-accessories and mothers-day-home-living-gifting (both verified via API to return the identical 104 products, same URLs' worth of content, as mothers-day-home-living - duplicate alias URLs, only mothers-day-home-living kept as canonical). (10) Eid, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Easter, Hanukkah - the sitemap-category.xml (27k+ URLs) was grepped for these terms and every plausible spelling (eid, ramadan, ramzan, easter, halloween, thanksgiving, hanukkah/chanukah) with zero matches; confirmed genuinely absent from this India-focused retailer's taxonomy (expected - Fabindia's only Western-calendar holiday presence is Christmas/xmas and New Year, and New Year has no Home Decor products).

All included counts are the site's own live OCC API totalResults for the exact category code at time of check (2026-09-04); minor +/-1 fluctuations were observed between repeat calls on Navaratri/Republic Day (live inventory changes), not a data-quality issue.
